An '''R2-series astromech droid''' was owned by [[Gen Tiraan]], an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who helped design the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]]. Tiraan had the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|droid]] with him in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]<ref name="Wanted" /> around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="WC Dates">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is set three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which the ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. ''Wanted by Cracken'' must therefore be set in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> where he was of interest to both the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for the development of a newer and more efficient [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]].<ref name="Wanted" />

{{RPGseed}}
A group of Republic operatives traveled to the Corellian [[Star system/Legends|system]] in search of Tiraan. Upon their arrival in the system, a [[Unidentified New Republic agent (Gen Tiraan)|Republic agent]] provided a copy of a scrambled transmission&mdash;containing plans for the engine&mdash;which he had detected being sent from one of the system's [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The group attempted to uncover Tiraan's location and rescue both him and his [[Astromech socket/Legends|astromech droid]] before the Empire, which was trying to leverage the engineer into their employ, could capture him.<ref name="Wanted" />
{{Endgame}}

Like all [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] of the [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] line, Tiraan's R2 unit was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]].<ref name="R-series note" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gen Tiraan's R2 unit was mentioned in [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], a [[1993]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]]. The droid was mentioned in Tiraan's game information among his equipment and was pictured alongside the engineer in an illustration by [[Mike Jackson]].<ref name="Wanted" />
